title: My Daily Routine
subtitle: 考点：一般现在时 / 时间表达 a quarter past
passage: I usually get up at a quarter past six. First, I take a shower and get dressed. Then I brush my teeth and have breakfast. I leave home for school at around seven.
After school, I do my homework. I go to bed at half past nine. This is my daily routine.
vocab: daily routine 日常生活 · usually 通常 · get up 起床 · take a shower 淋浴 · get dressed 穿衣服 · brush 刷 · tooth 牙齿 · around 大约 · homework 家庭作业 · go to bed 上床睡觉

questions.stem: What time does the writer usually get up?
What does the writer do first after getting up?
options: Takes a shower and gets dressed.

questions.stem: When does the writer leave home for school?
When does the writer go to bed?
